key_point: The game that hosted real weddings
title: The game that hosted real weddings
caption: During 2020 lockdowns, couples held weddings inside Animal Crossing: New Horizons. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #animalcrossing #acnh

instagram.caption:
Animal Crossing: New Horizons launched in March 2020, just as much of the world went into lockdown.

Couples whose weddings were cancelled held ceremonies on their islands, with friends and family attending as characters.

Birthdays, graduations and dates moved there too. A cozy game about a quiet island became a place to see each other.

Did Animal Crossing get you through 2020?
